title: Why Google DeepMind broke up the AlphaFold team
description: The artificial intelligence system largely accomplished the task it was built to solve, and researchers outside DeepMind have already been carrying its work forward
content:

title: Daft Punk’s Thomas Bangalter might be a robot, but even he’s not interested in AI music.
description:
He’s continuing his post-helmet media whirlwind and stopped by the Chanel Connects podcast, where the topic briefly turned toward AI. “I’m not really interested in the creative usage of artificial intelligence,” he says, noting that part of the creative process is experimentation and discovery, “The number one goal of this process is surprise.”
